about_desc: One place for OMSI 2 model conversion (Blender 2.79b · OmsiXConv), object and spline creation, and bus model viewing.
disclaimer_text:
Bus Depot is an unofficial tool and is not affiliated with Blender, OmsiXConv, or OMSI.

There is no guarantee that conversion results are accurate. The developer is not liable for file corruption, loss, or incorrect in-game rendering; all risks are assumed by the user.

Please backup important files and verify outputs before use. 'Fast conversion' is an experimental feature.

Use at your own risk.

obj_intro: Makes OMSI objects (.sco) from converted o3d models and copies the models and textures to OMSI's Sceneryobjects folder.
obj_models_hint: Choose a folder with o3d files, or drag one onto the window.
obj_mode_sub: One object per model, or all models in one object
obj_group_sub: Group name shown when picking objects in the map editor
obj_coll_sub: Vehicles and people collide with it. When combined, a model with "coll" in its name is used (else the largest)
obj_surf_sub: Vehicles and people can move on top of it (bridges, platforms)
obj_fixed_sub: Doesn't fall over or move when hit by a vehicle
spl_intro: Set the lanes, widths and sidewalks to make an OMSI road spline (.sli). If no texture is chosen, a default asphalt and paving texture are created.
spl_dir_sub: Two-way splits the lanes in half (right-hand traffic)
spl_fit_sub: Stretch the road texture once over the whole road, or once per lane
spl_repeat_sub: Road length covered by one texture tile
spl_tile_sub: Size covered by one sidewalk texture tile
spl_folder_sub: Folder created inside Splines. Textures go to its texture folder

spl_err_curb: Use a curb height of 0-1 m

spl_extra_sub: With an odd lane count, the side that gets one more lane (right = direction of travel)

view_both_sub: Off: front faces only, like OMSI (faces with flipped normals are hidden)

bus_intro: Open a bus (.bus) to view its model in 3D, check and edit repaints, animations, part blocks, passenger paths and seats, and save. Parts that are on can be saved as a Blender file or OBJ.
bus_empty: Choose a .bus file or drag one onto the window
bus_controls: Drag to rotate · right button to pan · wheel to zoom · double-click to reset · click a part to edit it · drag path points and seats to move them (Shift: 1 m steps) · drag the red/green/blue arrows of the selected point or seat to move along x/y/z only
bus_hide_model_sub: Turn the whole model off and see only passenger paths and seats
view_controls: Drag to rotate · right button to pan · wheel to zoom · double-click to reset
bus_show_paths_sub: Points and links from paths.cfg (orange = entry, red = exit)
bus_show_seats_sub: Seats from passengercabin.cfg (pink = driver), the bar shows the facing direction
bus_show_pivots_sub: Pivot (dot) and axis (bar) for each block of the part being edited
bus_order_sub: Try the other one if the motion differs from the game
bus_flip_sub: Turn on if doors or needles turn the wrong way
bus_vars_hint: Changing a value moves the parts that use the variable (angle = value × factor)
bus_links_sub: Pick two point numbers to link

map_empty: The layout appears here when you open a map folder
map_controls: Drag to move · wheel to zoom · double-click to see all · red = missing file
map_show_splines_sub: Roads, rails, overhead wires etc. (curves follow their radius)
map_missing_only_sub: Show only objects and splines missing from the OMSI folder (red)
map_more_sub: Use 'Copy list' to get the full list
